analysis: The biomedical plan offers substantive anatomy, physiology, immunology, disease mechanisms, pharmacology, laboratory methods and research appraisal. Functional Anatomy and disease case work contribute human-system reasoning without a longitudinal clinical assessment sequence. Pharmacology develops drug mechanisms and therapeutic principles without prescribing practice. The health psychology plan adds social and organisational psychology, health behaviour, qualitative inquiry, inclusive leadership and persuasion. This is supporting evidence for the interpersonal side of healthcare, not clinical consultation. Later review should reconsider whether the clinical academic gap precludes a comparison, and examine prevention and public-health candidates beyond Epidemiology, including Medical & Health Psychology and policy or intervention methods. Neither a missing prerequisite nor an unavailable offering determines the academic disposition.
